## Goal
Implement the requested change from the agent mention.

## Original request
> Current behavior:
> 
> resolve-pending-update-pr.sh finds an open agent/update-agent-infra-* PR.
> It outputs skip=true.
> The update job does not run.
> If force=true, the guard is bypassed, but the workflow still checks out the default branch and invokes update-agent as a normal update run. It does not pass the existing PR number/branch into the agent. So it is not a reliable “update the existing PR” path.
> 
> To support updating an existing update PR, we need a different flow:
> 
> detect existing PR;
> output existing_pr_number and existing_pr_branch;
> let the update job run against that branch;
> tell update-agent explicitly: “update PR #N / branch X instead of opening a new PR”;
> push changes to the same branch.
> So: current behavior is skip, not update. If we want existing PR adoption, that needs to be implemented explicitly.
> 
> 

@sepo-agent /implement work on this in a stacked PR

## Acceptance criteria
- Implement the requested change.
- Preserve existing behavior unless the request requires a change.
- Update tests or validation as needed.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/116

**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-203/codex-25649928046`
- Pull request: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/204

Implemented existing Sepo update PR adoption on top of PR #116: the pending update PR resolver now reports matching update PR metadata without skipping, the update workflow checks out an existing update PR branch when present and passes that context to the update-agent skill, and docs/tests now describe and enforce updating the existing PR instead of opening a duplicate. Verified with build, shell syntax, YAML parsing, diff check, and focused pending-gate/envelope tests.
